description: Have you seen this sign surrounded by city trash bags? Instead of just putting up advertisement, Karen and friends are letting the public know they are cleaning up several areas in the MO State House Representative, District #19. Karen is quoted saying, "It is not about me it is about working together to address issues and overcome challenges." Let her know how she can help at Spalding4Missouri@gmail.com or contacting her through this website.
title: Serving the Community
